summary: Add invoke-grant (operation='invoke', resource_type='agent') scoped to agent_role×org_scope, with request (propose-task) and command (execute stub + audit) paths, a new invoke_proposal table (migration 043), and canonical audit via the T-0031 seam.
functional: FR-1: Invoke-grant is explicit — a row in choros.grant with operation='invoke' and resource_type='agent'; no implicit grant path.
FR-2: Grant scope is a lattice ScopeElement over org hierarchy; resource_facet carries agent_role_id of the target agent's assigned role.
FR-3: POST /api/invoke/request checks invoke-grant, inserts invoke_proposal row (status='proposed'), emits audit event 'invoke.request'.
FR-4: POST /api/invoke/command checks invoke-grant, emits audit event 'invoke.command', returns 202 with invocation_id; dispatch is a day-1 stub.
FR-5: Both paths emit AuditEventInput through the canonical appendAuditEvent seam (T-0031); actor=caller, subject=target agent.
FR-6: Invoke-grants are created and revoked via the existing POST /api/grants and POST /api/grants/:id/revoke endpoints with operation='invoke'.
FR-7: Invoke-grant is delegable by default; sub-delegation gated by validateNarrowing (T-0018); delegable:false is non-transferable.
FR-8: target_agent_id must resolve to an agent_card row (employee.kind='agent'); human target yields 400 VALIDATION.

FR-9: New table choros.invoke_proposal (migration 043) with columns: tenant_id, id, caller_id, target_id, goal, context, status CHECK IN ('proposed','cancelled'), created_at; tenant-isolation invariants (RLS, GUC policy, choros_app grant, known_tenant_tables.txt).
non_functional: NF-1: All changes to grant-lattice.ts, grant-resolver.ts, grants.ts are additive only — no refactoring of existing logic.
NF-2: resolveFor (T-0021) is called with op='invoke'; no second grant-check path is introduced.
NF-3: All audit writes use appendAuditEvent (T-0016/T-0031 canonical seam) — no local/partial writers.
NF-4: Absent or expired invoke-grant → 403 FORBIDDEN; no invoke_proposal row inserted; fail-closed.
NF-5: Every DB read/write inside withTenantTx with choros.tenant_id GUC set.
NF-6: Caller identity from X-Dev-User header (dev convention); production auth is T-0060's scope.
out_of_scope: Actual agent runtime dispatch — day-1 command path is a stub.
Proposal promotion from proposed→executing (human gate, future task).
invoke_proposal cancellation endpoint (status column present, no cancel route day-1).

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/invoke/request with valid invoke-grant returns 201 Created; invoke_proposal row exists with status='proposed', correct caller_id, target_id, goal.
POST /api/invoke/request with no covering invoke-grant (absent or scope mismatch) returns 403 FORBIDDEN; no invoke_proposal row inserted.
POST /api/invoke/command with valid invoke-grant returns 202 Accepted with JSON body containing invocation_id (UUID).
POST /api/invoke/command with no covering invoke-grant returns 403 FORBIDDEN.
After successful POST /api/invoke/request, exactly one audit_event row with type='invoke.request', actor=caller_id, subject=target_agent_id, payload.mode='request'.
After successful POST /api/invoke/command, exactly one audit_event row with type='invoke.command', actor=caller_id, subject=target_agent_id, payload.mode='command'.
Invoking a target_agent_id not in agent_card (or kind='human') returns 400 VALIDATION regardless of grant presence.
POST /api/grants with operation='invoke', resource_type='agent' stores a row in choros.grant and emits a grant.create audit event.
After POST /api/grants/:id/revoke on an invoke-grant, POST /api/invoke/request returns 403 FORBIDDEN.
invoke_proposal has RLS enabled+forced; querying with a different choros.tenant_id GUC returns no rows from another tenant's proposals.
A sub-delegated invoke-grant (narrower org_scope) is valid only within its narrower scope; a target outside that scope returns 403.
invoke_proposal is listed in ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt; the frozen-file fitness check passes without CI red.
grant-lattice.ts fitness test count does not decrease: all 122 T-0018 tests still pass after T-0024 lands.
resolveFor signature is unchanged; callers omitting the optional invokeCtx param compile without error (additive-only check).
